Subject: Oxbridge MAP: SOC2 evidence timeline & POC confirmation

Hi Anna / Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + the MAP draft attached so we have one source of truth while we scope the security milestone.

Call recap (high level):
- Primary objective: get Oxbridge onboarded to Redwood for inference workloads while meeting your SOC 2 gating requirements.
- Key risk: access model for logs/evidence and timing of vendor review cycles.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Security kickoff (Redwood <> Oxbridge) — Jun 20 (30 min) — owner: Oxbridge Security POC
2) SOC 2 questionnaire completion — Jul 8 — owner: Oxbridge (answer non-technical Qs)
3) Evidence collection (logs/configs/controls) — new target: Jul 22 (see note below) — owner: joint (Oxbridge provides, Redwood prepares exports)
4) SOC 2 package delivery to your auditor — Jul 29 — owner: Redwood (deliverables: questionnaire, evidence manifest, export links)
5) Target commercial close / signature — Jul 30 — owner: commercial stakeholders

Dependencies / asks from Oxbridge:
- Confirm security POC (name + preferred contact)
- Confirm method to transfer evidence (S3 read-only link vs secure upload)
- Provide any date constraints for internal audit windows (so we avoid auditor blackout windows)

Redwood commitments:
- Attached MAP draft (RDW_MAP_Draft_Oxbridge_v1.xlsx) with milestone owners and due dates.
- SOC2 questionnaire (SOC2_questionnaire_oxbridge_v1.pdf) prefilled with known answers where possible.
- Ben Carter will run a short technical walkthrough (30 min) on Jun 23 to go over export formats and where logs live.

Can you confirm the security POC and whether Jul 22 for evidence collection is workable? If needed we can slide evidence due to Jul 22 -> Jul 29 but that will shift final delivery by one week.

Thanks — I'll update the MAP doc after we hear back.

Best,
Tessa Morgan

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear recap. A couple of notes/questions from our security team: 

1) Evidence window: our internal audit window runs Jul 18–25 and we'd prefer to avoid heavy vendor intake during that week. Could we shift the evidence collection deadline to Jul 22 (end of day) or, if needed, Jul 26?

2) Segmented delivery: would Redwood be able to deliver the SOC2 package in stages (questionnaire + subset of evidence first, remaining artifacts later), or do you prefer bundling everything together at the final handoff? Staggered delivery helps our auditor triage.

3) Encryption & retention: can you confirm at a high level whether logs exported for evidence will have field-level redaction options and if exports are encrypted at rest and in transit?

I've attached a short doc listing our constraints and a couple of legal items to flag (Oxbridge_Security_Constraints.docx).

Samir will be our security POC for the intake — Samir, will you confirm?

Anna Lowe
Head of Security Programs | Oxbridge Financial

Hi Anna / Samir — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging the audit window.

We can accommodate the audit window and adjust the MAP: new proposed evidence collection due date Jul 22 (EOD). Final SOC2 package delivery would move to Jul 29 and commercial close to Aug 5 if you want the extra week; otherwise Jul 30 is still possible if you deliver evidence by Jul 22.

Answers to your questions:
- Staged delivery: yes — we can stage. First drop will include the completed questionnaire + key control exports (config snapshots, access control lists, sample logs). Second drop will include full artifact exports and manifests. Please note staged delivery requires an agreed manifest so your auditor knows what's still pending.
- Encryption & redaction: exports are encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES-256). We can support simple redaction of PII fields in log exports prior to package creation; for field-level redaction we'd need a short mapping from your side to make sure we're removing the right fields.

Dependencies (to move forward):
- Samir confirmed as security POC (please confirm preferred email/phone) — thanks for stepping in.
- Access method: we can accept a read-only S3 bucket (preferred) or secure upload portal. Please let us know which you prefer.
- Questionnaire: please complete the non-technical questions in the attached PDF by Jul 8 so we can prefill technical answers.

Updated attachments: RDW_MAP_Draft_Oxbridge_v2.xlsx (I've updated owners/dates to reflect the audit window). I've also added a link to the shared MAP in Drive and the HubSpot record for traceability.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/oxbridge/rdw-map-oxbridge-v2
HubSpot: HS-987654321

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to run the tech walkthrough on Jun 23 (30 min) — Ben, can you confirm availability?
- Samir to confirm preferred transfer method and provide contact details for legal procurement.

If that all looks good I'll push RDW_MAP_Draft_Oxbridge_v2.xlsx to the shared drive and lock the milestone dates.

Thanks,
